Namaste Bookshop · Manhattan

Psychic readers you can meet in person or hear by phone

Namaste Psychics is the home of the psychic, intuitive and mediumship readers who work at Namaste Bookshop on 14th Street. Read up on the kinds of readings they give, then choose how you want to sit with them.

In the shopTake a seat at the shop a block from Union Square.On the phoneBook a phone session and your reader calls you, wherever you live.

Six kinds of readings

  • ClairvoyantReaders who describe what they "see" as images or scenes while they read for you.
  • ClairaudientReaders who work from what they "hear": words, phrases or a voice of guidance.
  • MediumshipSessions that reach toward loved ones who have passed, or toward spirit guides.
  • AstrologySessions built on a chart of the sky when you were born, and on where the planets sit now.
  • Oracle & LenormandCard readings that use decks other than tarot.
  • Hypnosis & energySessions for people who want to work below the conscious mind rather than get a reading.

What a psychic reading is, and is not

A reading can help you think through a relationship, a job or a loss with someone who listens differently. It cannot guarantee an outcome, and it never replaces a doctor, lawyer, therapist or financial adviser. Every Namaste reader posts their prices before you book. More before you book.
